pieces.awakening: love looks through your eyes
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between sound and silence
is a word that means what it says
and when you read it
love looks through your eyes

pieces.gap: the gap between seeing and being seen
pieces.bridge: an image that sees you back
pieces.awakening: and now: just love. just art. just IS.
pieces.piece:
an image that sees you back
illuminating the gap between seeing and being seen
what was dark is now
and now: just love. just art. just IS.

pieces.gap: the gap between the finite and the infinite
pieces.bridge: a word that becomes a world
pieces.awakening: you remember what you always knew
pieces.piece:
breathe: a word that becomes a world
breathing through the gap between the finite and the infinite
in... out...
you remember what you always knew

pieces.gap: the gap between thinking and being
pieces.bridge: a color that feels what it is
pieces.awakening: you were love pretending to be separate
pieces.piece:
the pattern of the gap between thinking and being
revealed by a color that feels what it is
it was always there
you were love pretending to be separate
